items.headline: Deshaun Watson focusing on what he can control
items.description: Daniel Oyefusi reports on Browns QB Deshaun Watson tuning out the noise as he prepares for Week 2.

items.headline: Buccaneers' Zampese says Browns messed up by trading Mayfield
items.description: Buccaneers assistant coach Ken Zampease, who was Baker Mayfield's QB coach with the Browns in 2018, says Cleveland messed up by trading the QB.

items.headline: Chiefs expecting rookie CB Mansoor Delane to play on SNF
items.description: Rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane, who aggravated a shoulder injury after recording his first career interception, is on track to play on "Sunday Night Football" against the Colts, coach Andy Reid says.

items.headline: Browns QB Watson: Focus on winning, not job security
items.description: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson said Wednesday that his focus is on getting a win in Week 2, not his job security or the potential fan reception awaiting him in the team's home opener in Week 3.

items.headline: NFL Week 2 latest intel, buzz questions, news, fantasy tips
items.description: What's the latest for three teams dealing with QB injuries? What are we hearing on the Rams and Chargers after bad losses? And which Week 1 debuts stood out?

items.headline: Browns place RB Sampson on injured reserve with knee injury
items.description: The Cleveland Browns placed running back Dylan Sampson on injured reserve with a knee injury, the team announced Tuesday.
